convert an IN subquery to a semi-join
optimized_sql:
WITH store_sales_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk
    FROM date_dim
    JOIN store_sales
        ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2002
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
),
web_sales_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk
    FROM date_dim
    JOIN web_sales
        ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2002
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
),
catalog_sales_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT cs_ship_customer_sk
    FROM date_dim
    JOIN catalog_sales
        ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2002
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
)
SELECT cd_gender,
       cd_marital_status,
       cd_education_status,
       count(*) cnt1,
       cd_purchase_estimate,
       count(*) cnt2,
       cd_credit_rating,
       count(*) cnt3
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address ca
    ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics
    ON cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
WHERE ca_state IN ('IL','TX','ME')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM store_sales_filtered
      WHERE c.c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
  )
  AND (
      NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM web_sales_filtered
          WHERE c.c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM catalog_sales_filtered
          WHERE c.c_customer_sk = cs_ship_customer_sk
      )
  )
GROUP BY cd_gender,
         cd_marital_status,
         cd_education_status,
         cd_purchase_estimate,
         cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY cd_gender,
         cd_marital_status,
         cd_education_status,
         cd_purchase_estimate,
         cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
